feed.title: ROSA LAB
feed.subtitle: ROSA LAB is a research group focusing on graph theory and optimization in the Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering at National Central University (NCU).

entry.content: ROSA LAB held an internal seminar focused on graph theory, optimization modeling, and practical computational approaches for large-scale decision problems.

entry.title: New project in social analytics
entry.content: This project expands our work on social analytics by combining network analysis, structured modeling, and practical data applications.
